intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文讽刺线记忆：穿 jeans 站在高档店橱窗前，犹豫后进店要看 dress，被 assistant 轻蔑拒绝，生气离开；第二天同一个人换正式 coat 回来，assistant 没认出她，态度从 scornfully 变成 eager，最后她才买下最开始要看的那条。读的时候注意外表判断、态度对比和几个句首短语的停顿。

sentences.text: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一位穿 jeans 的女人站在高档商店橱窗前。A woman in jeans 连起来读，at the window 是 shop window 的位置。

sentences.text: Though she hesitated for a moment, she finally went in and asked to see a dress that was in the window.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她犹豫了一会儿，但最后还是进去要看橱窗里的 dress。Though she hesitated 后短停，finally went in 推动动作。

sentences.text: Glancing at her scornfully, he told her that the dress was sold.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他轻蔑地看了她一眼，说那件 dress 已经卖了。Glancing at her scornfully 是态度重点，the dress was sold 读成冷淡的结果。

sentences.text: The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant next day.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：女人生气地走出商店，决定第二天教训这个 assistant。walked out angrily 读出生气，decided to punish 是故事里的喜剧教训。

sentences.text: She returned to the shop the following morning dressed in a fur coat, with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：第二天上午她穿着正式贵气的 coat 回来，一手拿 handbag，另一手拿 long umbrella。长句按 returned / dressed in / with 分组。

sentences.text: Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：assistant 没认出她，这一次非常殷勤地接待她。Not realizing who she was 后短停，eager to serve 读出和 scornfully 的对比。

sentences.text: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：他费了好大劲儿爬进橱窗去拿那条 dress。With great difficulty 要先读出费劲感，climbed into the shop window 是画面动作。

sentences.text: She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything in the window before finally buying the dress she had first asked for.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她让 assistant 几乎把橱窗里的东西都拿出来，最后才买下最开始想看的那条 dress。长句按 enjoyed herself / making the assistant bring / before finally buying 分组。
